cardOverview.overviewText: AU CA Metal is a premium metal credit card built for high-spend users, offering elevated rewards on everyday categories like online, travel, and dining. It includes milestone bonuses, complimentary lounge access, and premium support, delivering a luxury card experience without the super-premium price tag.

eligibility: Spend a minimum of Re. 1 in a calendar quarter to become eligible for Complimentary Domestic Airport Lounge Access in the same calendar quarter.
